section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the use of the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos et al., 2005), modified to assess the past 24 hours, with daily ratings from 1 (never) to 5 (always). It reports high internal consistency in the current study (Cronbach's alpha range .95 to .96) and a mean weekly BAS of 3.37 (SD = 0.76) across participants. The section does not provide sample size, demographic details (e.g., country, age, race), BMI assessment, or correlations between BAS and BMI.
